hero.title: Gather your party. Your legend starts here.
hero.description: Find a table, follow your Dungeon Master and write your name into the chronicles of YukMainDnD.

pitch.title: What is YukMainDnD?
pitch.description: A guild for Dungeons & Dragons and other tabletop RPGs. Join stories, meet guildmates and track your adventures in one place.

friends.title: Play with friends
friends.description: Pick an open story, claim a seat and roll dice with a party of fellow adventurers, online or at the table.

rewards.title: Earn EXP & rewards
rewards.description: Every finished story grants experience and gold pieces. Level up and climb the monthly legends.

dm.title: Become a DM
dm.description: Ready to weave your own tale? Run stories for the guild and earn Dungeon Master experience.

stories.title: Open stories
stories.description: Tables still seeking brave adventurers. Claim your seat before the party sets out.
stories.error: The quest board could not be read.
stories.empty: No stories are posted on the board right now. Check back soon.

legends.description: The adventurers and Dungeon Masters who gained the most EXP in {{month}}.
legends.descriptionFallback: The adventurers and Dungeon Masters who gained the most EXP in the previous month.
legends.emptyFallback: No legends yet in the previous month. The tavern awaits.
legends.errorTitle: The legends are lost to the mist
legends.errorDescription: We could not read this board. Please try again.
legends.emptyWithMonth: No legends yet in {{month}}. The tavern awaits.

guild.title: Life in the guild
guild.description: A circle of friends who roll dice, share tales and get gloriously lost in dungeons together. New faces are always welcome by the hearth.

sessionNight.caption: One of our fun session night

heroesAtTable.caption: Heroes at the table

cta.title: Ready for your first story?
cta.description: The tavern is warm and a seat is waiting for you.
